name: app-shater-two-apps-installed-side-by-side-on-iphone-home-screen
title: Shater client and craftsman apps shown installed side by side on an iPhone home screen
whatItIs: Two cropped iPhone home screens on orange: one labelled 'تطبيق العميل' (Client App) with the blue Shater icon among Calendar, Photos, Camera and Mail; the other 'تطبيق الحرفي' (Craftsman App) with an orange 'Shater Craftsman' icon in the same layout, plus supporting app screenshots beside each.
whatItMeans: Real and installable; seeing both icons live on a phone's home screen proves the two-app strategy actually shipped.
techniques: Distinguish sibling apps with a different icon colour.
Show the icon in situ among familiar system apps.
Pair each home screen with its in-app UI beside it.

vocabulary.definition: The small image representing an app on a home screen.
Showing a design in its real, expected context.
